newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end 1.08 pct up, seen rising.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end 1.08 pct up, seen rising.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended 1.04 percent up on Wednesday, mainly on speculative activity ahead of February 3 elections, and dealers said they expected the Karachi 100-share index to rise further in the near term.

"Election euphoria pushed the index up. Most activity was generated by speculators on hopes that Nawaz Sharif will win the elections, but volumes remained low as investors seem in a wait-and-see mood," dealer Sameera Manto said.
Sharif is seen as pro-business. The index rose 15.44 points, to end at 1,445.07 amid 137 gainers and 75 losers. PTCL rose 0.50 rupees to 28.40. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
